title: 10 Best Microsoft Teams Apps for IT Support in 2026
summary: Improve IT support with the 10 best Microsoft Teams apps in 2026. Streamline ticket management, automate tasks, and enhance team collaboration.
body_markdown:
IT teams now handle a growing volume of employee requests directly in Microsoft Teams, from password resets and software access to hardware issues, VPN troubleshooting, and account provisioning. The challenge is not whether employees will ask for help in Teams. The challenge is whether IT can turn those conversations into[structured, trackable tickets](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support?ref=unthread.io) without forcing employees into a separate help desk portal.


Manual request tracking creates real operational costs. Internal support teams without automation can spend 8-15 hours per week on manual triage, while teams without structured ticketing can experience 60-75% higher rates of missed requests.


The right Teams support setup helps IT respond where employees already work while maintaining ownership, SLAs, routing, and reporting.


## **Key Takeaways**


- IT teams should prioritize Microsoft Teams apps that support conversational ticketing, AI automation, structured routing, SLA tracking, and reporting without forcing employees into separate portals.
- Unthread is the recommended option for organizations that need internal support across Slack and Teams, purpose-built AI agents for ticket resolution, and unified help desk workflows.
- ServiceNow, Freshservice, and Jira Service Management are relevant for organizations that need structured ITSM processes, change management, asset management, and enterprise service workflows.
- Teams-native tools such as Desk365, Tikit, and TeamsWork can keep more of the ticketing workflow inside Microsoft Teams.
- The right setup should keep ticket submission straightforward for employees while giving IT the structure needed to manage workflows, escalations, and cross-team handoffs.


## **What IT Teams Should Look for in a Microsoft Teams App**


IT support has different requirements from customer service or general project management. An infrastructure request, account provisioning workflow, or security incident needs structure, ownership, and accountability. At the same time, employees expect to request help from the tools they already use.


A strong Microsoft Teams app for IT support should help teams:


- Convert Teams conversations into trackable tickets
- Route requests by topic, priority, urgency, or employee context
- Automate recurring Tier 1 questions through AI deflection
- Build a reusable[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base/?ref=unthread.io) from resolved requests
- Track SLAs and ownership across IT queues
- Connect identity, ITSM, and business systems through[integration capabilities](https://unthread.io/products/integrations/?ref=unthread.io)
- Support cross-functional handoffs between IT, HR, finance, procurement, and other internal teams


The key distinction is often whether a tool is Teams-native, allowing more work to happen directly in Microsoft Teams, or Teams-connected, where Teams serves as an intake or notification layer while administration happens elsewhere.

## **2) ServiceNow**


ServiceNow is an enterprise service management platform that supports IT service delivery through structured workflows, automation, and integrations with employee collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams.


It is relevant for organizations that manage IT support alongside formal incident, problem, change, and request management processes.


### **Where It Fits**


ServiceNow is commonly evaluated by large organizations that need centralized IT service management across multiple departments, business systems, and employee groups.


Its Microsoft Teams integration can help employees access service information and interact with support workflows through a familiar communication interface.


### **IT-Relevant Capabilities**


- Microsoft Teams integration for employee service interactions
- Virtual Agent for conversational assistance and service request handling
- Incident, problem, and change management
- IT asset and configuration management
- Automated request routing and approvals
- Knowledge management and employee self-service
- Enterprise workflow orchestration across IT and business departments


### **What IT Teams Should Review**


IT teams should assess how ServiceNow's broader enterprise service management capabilities align with their implementation resources, internal processes, and configuration requirements.


Organizations should also evaluate which employee interactions can happen directly in Microsoft Teams and which activities require the ServiceNow interface.

Its workflow includes separate experiences for end users and support agents, helping teams organize internal requests without requiring employees to adopt a separate ticket submission process.


### **IT-Relevant Capabilities**


- Support and agent bots for request management
- Agent workspace accessible through Microsoft Teams
- Microsoft Entra ID SSO
- Asset management with Microsoft Intune synchronization on applicable plans
- Custom ticket fields and status workflows
- SLA tracking
- Ticket assignment and status management


### **What IT Teams Should Review**


Teams should assess whether Desk365's Teams-centered approach aligns with their broader ITSM requirements, particularly if they also need extensive cross-channel intake, complex service management processes, or workflows spanning multiple internal departments.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What makes a Microsoft Teams app useful for IT support?**


A Microsoft Teams app can help IT convert employee conversations into structured requests with ownership, routing, status tracking, and SLA management. The strongest options also support automation, knowledge management, analytics, and integrations with the systems IT teams already use. For organizations coordinating requests across departments, a structured[internal help desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/employee-support/?ref=unthread.io) also helps maintain visibility into employee service workflows.


### **What is the difference between Teams-native and Teams-connected tools?**


Teams-native tools allow more of the request and ticket lifecycle to happen directly within Microsoft Teams. Teams-connected tools use Teams for intake, notifications, approvals, or selected actions while relying on a separate service management interface for other administrative tasks. The distinction matters when organizations want employees and IT agents to complete more work without switching applications.


### **Can AI help resolve IT support tickets automatically?**


Yes. AI can resolve or deflect routine requests when it has access to approved internal knowledge and appropriate workflows. Unthread's purpose-built AI agents use internal knowledge and ticket context to automate common requests and escalate issues that need human attention. In one customer example, Lemonade reported[approximately 40%](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) automatic ticket resolution across its internal teams.


### **What should IT teams check before choosing a Microsoft Teams ticketing platform?**


IT teams should review Microsoft Teams integration depth, AI automation, routing flexibility, SLA tracking, knowledge management, analytics, security controls, identity integrations, and support for the complete request lifecycle. The right platform should work for employees submitting requests and for the IT teams responsible for resolving them.
